subject: DEFINE directive
notes: kb/Work PB1368 (w1006c). cite.py --check 7.3.11.4 "in a constant entry where the FROM phrase is specified" -> OK GR1. All three permitted uses now honored: (a) directive operands (IF/EVALUATE/DEFINE/DISPLAY) through the evaluator's live table; (b) CONSTANT ... FROM compilation-variable-name-1 reads the >>DEFINE TIMELINE (DirectiveResults.CompilationVariables, PUSH/POP replayed) at the entry's own line - GR1 'in text that follows a DEFINE', so a DEFINE after the entry does not reach it (negative pb1368-constant-from-defined-later) and an OVERRIDE between two entries gives each its own value (2002 golden CT=1 CU=2); (c) a >>COBOL-WORDS literal slot takes a variable defined before the directive whose value is alphanumeric (2023 golden: EQUATE W1 WITH W2 makes SHOW a DISPLAY synonym); a numeric variable there is refused COBOL1623 (the category clause of GR1).
